The timing of the initial development of such anti-viral responses is… 13469921 characteristics-of-the-earliest-cross-neutralizing-antibody-response-to-hiv-1 characteristics earliest cross neutralizing antibody response hiv recent Recent cross-sectional analyses of HIV-1+ plasmas have indicated that broadly cross-reactive neutralizing antibody respons Characteristics of the Earliest Cross-Neutralizing Antibody Response to HIV-1 Recent cross-sectional analyses of HIV-1+ plasmas have indicated that broadly cross-reactive neutralizing antibody responses are developed by 10%-30% of HIV-1+ subjects. The timing of the initial development of such anti-viral responses is unknown. It is also unknown whether the emergence of these responses coincides with the appearance of antibody specificities to a single or multiple regions of the viral envelope glycoprotein (Env). Here we analyzed the cross-neutralizing antibody responses in longitudinal plasmas collected soon after and up to seven years after HIV-1 infection.
